title: The demo QA gate never passes a demo without a trustworthy baseline, and holds the hand-off prompt until it has one
steps: S1: QA round with a lost baseline.
S2: a check the host could not judge.
S3: hand-off whose baseline read fails.
expect: S2: left to a person, no repair sent.
S3: no prompt sent; sweep reads again and sends it, or gives up.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: baseline null/empty made no-demo-pictures skip and no-demo-words compare against nothing, so demos kept template content and passed
fence: An unjudged check is never a pass

tests: B1: a run whose baseline is lost ends needs-review without asking the host — never passed
B1: a round where a check could not be judged leaves the demo to a person, with no repair sent
B1: a baseline that could not be read holds the prompt; the sweep reads again and sends it, or gives up
